admin.labKaWalkIn: = the lab's walk-in rate (what the lab charges at its counter). Patients never pay more than this.
admin.rate100CommissionPoore: = rate × (100 − commission%), rounded to whole rupees. If an agent/admin set a different B2B rate for a test, that is used (marked "custom" in the rate card).
admin.patientRateLabKa: = patient rate − lab's share. This is your profit.
admin.jabTestsKaTotal: ): when the tests total less than ₹
admin.haiLabKaHissa: ; the lab gets no share of it.
admin.bookingKeTimeJo: : the rate at booking time applies. Changing a rate later doesn't change old bookings.
admin.peKisiKaKoi: — no money is due to anyone.
admin.cashPaymentLabNe: Cash payment (the lab took it from the patient)
admin.pooraPaisaLabKe: All the money is with the lab.
admin.labPlatformKoUska: The lab pays the platform its share (commission + collection fee).
admin.pooraPaisaPlatformKe: All the money is with the platform.
admin.platformLabKoUska: The platform pays the lab its share (B2B).
admin.somvaarSubah6Baje: : every Monday at 6 am last week's account is made automatically. Final = lab's share − cash with the lab. If positive the platform pays the lab; if negative the lab pays the platform.
admin.paymentKeBaadAdmin: After payment the admin enters the UTR/reference and marks the settlement "paid". Those bookings are never counted again.
admin.gintiSirfUnBookings: Only bookings whose sample was collected are counted (collected / report given).
admin.harBookingKaOtp: Each booking's OTP is made once and never changes. It does not expire with time.
admin.otpSirfTabBand: The OTP stops only when the booking is cancelled, the sample is collected, or a wrong OTP is entered 5 times (then the booking locks).
admin.doctorAppointmentKeReceipt: The same rules apply to the doctor appointment receipt code.
